summary: Align .agents/rules/AGENT.md, PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, RUNBOOK.md, README.md, and .logbook/ (LOGBOOK.md + progress.jsonl) with seumignon-backend governance and define E0-E4 frontend roadmap

Complete /grill-me visual discovery across visual_references/ and document modular logo/mascot system, dual-theme A/B Design Tokens (#10388B Blue Bistro vs. #CB2031 Red Kraft), WelcomePromoModal flow, 3x4 visual side-counter grid, and food photography guidelines in .logbook/LOGBOOK.md

Bootstrap React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Vitest + ESLint + Prettier + GitHub Actions CI; implement pure src/domain/ (integer centavos math, 3/3 choice_groups validator, delivery_zones search), src/services/api.ts HTTP client, and dual-theme A/B App shell passing all 12 low_gear/high_gear tests and quality gate

Implement WelcomePromoModal with campaign persistence, BoizinhoMascot 1930s rubber-hose SVG, CategoryTabs, DishCard, and Sweetgreen-inspired 3x4 DishCustomizationModal enforcing 3/3 included sides without paid-extra clutter, verified by 14 low_gear and high_gear tests

Fix opaque sticky header background on scroll and implement Epic E3 CartContext with localStorage persistence, searchable NeighborhoodSelector across pre-calculated 500/800/900 centavos delivery_zones, responsive CartPanel + mobile drawer, and CheckoutModal submitting POST /orders with Pagar.me checkout_url handoff

Implement src/domain/orderStatus.ts state machine, src/pages/OrderStatusPage.tsx (/orders/:orderId) with live GET /orders/{order_id} polling (PENDING -> PAID -> DISPATCHED | CANCELLED), Pagar.me payment link recovery CTA, Touchpoint #4 BoizinhoMascot, Cloudflare Pages SPA fallback (public/_redirects), and low_gear/high_gear tests

Documented architectural decisions and planned roadmap order in LOGBOOK.md: E5 (Authoritative CEP Delivery Fee & Local UX), E6 (Optional Passwordless Auth via Google/Cognito), and E7 (White-Label Brand Config Template for sibling restaurant & freelance reuse)

Align seumignon-frontend with production seumignon-backend contracts (E8/E9/E11/E12): authoritative GET /delivery-fee?cep=... quote flow replacing manual zone selection, district+postal_code POST /orders payload, optional 2-step Passwordless Email OTP auth, /me/profile autofill, /me/orders cloud history, and 401 Guest Checkout fallback

Lock UI palette to Red Kraft (#CB2031 on #F5EFE2) with Oswald + Plus Jakarta Sans typography, remove header theme switcher, and add curated catalog shortcuts (Os mais pedidos, Grelhados, Clássicos da Cozinha, Acompanhamentos, Sobremesa, Bebidas, Todos) with low_gear/high_gear tests

Remove menu search input and horizontal scrollbar from CategoryTabs, and split unauthenticated AccountModal into 'Já tenho conta' (with automatic profile prompt on 404) and 'Criar minha conta' (upfront registration form persisted via PUT /me/profile immediately after Email OTP verification)

Send create_if_missing=false on login OTP requests and create_if_missing=true only on upfront registration; handle 404 UserNotFoundError/ProfileNotFoundError by switching automatically to 'Criar minha conta' with pre-filled email without requesting an OTP code
